problem: Native Word exposed inline/display Office Math misclassification and ignorable comment paragraph IDs being discarded. Broader corpus testing also exposed a nested-textbox selection error in the formatting preservation test oracle.
changes: Classify oMath by an oMathPara ancestor, including direct paragraph siblings used by Word. Keep legacy run-nested reads, namespace-aware aliases and strict bindings, exact raw fragments, byte-order-mark offsets and finite scan bounds.

Typed equation getters redeclare inherited source namespaces; add_inline_office_math emits a direct paragraph child. Native DOCX/DOTX equations can be reused alongside text with the correct inline/display envelope.
Retain the modeled Word 2010 namespace in comment markup-compatibility processing so paragraph IDs remain linked to reply metadata.

Correct the formatting test oracle to compare direct paragraph/run property children rather than properties inside a nested text box. The independent byte-preservation assertion outside the edited property container remains unchanged.

Add eleven native Word owner tests and one operations test covering catalogs, source-preserving edits/inverses, nested tables, section geometry, secondary stories, review identities/timestamps, moves, encryption, inert macro inspection and master/child boundaries.

verification_scope.variants: 24 unencrypted DOCX/DOTX/DOCM/DOTM/extensionless-child packages plus one encrypted DOCX; package payload preservation is distinct from semantic feature coverage.
verification_scope.edits: Title changes across 13 native packages; unrelated member bytes and source immutability; all member payloads restored by inverse patches. Two nested-table path changes additionally tested on eager/source-backed operations owners.
verification_scope.publication: ZIP framing is not a preservation oracle: serializing after reopening may change container bytes. Tests compare complete member sets and every decompressed payload, including inert embedded assets.
verification_scope.protection: Comments/forms protection and tracking state cause typed Protected refusal for changed publication; no-op remains valid. The native unprotected form accepts an edit.
verification_scope.encryption: Public disposable Office42! password, absent/wrong passwords, AgileAes256Sha512 provenance, explicit plaintext publication policy, rekey and old-key refusal; all clear members preserved in memory.
verification_scope.macros: DOCM/DOTM VBA relationship graph, module source markers, reference count and native payload SHA-256 checks; no compilation or execution.
verification_scope.corpus_environment: Materialized tracked test-data/Open-XML-SDK and test-data/officecli fixtures required by existing tests. No fixture source bytes changed and no 3rdparty references introduced.
